title: Aph. XVI-XVIII: New Testament canonical books; four integral parts; evangelical part
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss: Mark, Luke, plus John — concerning the conception, birth, teaching, life, wonderful works, passion, death, departure to the Father, plus return belonging toward Jesus belonging toward Nazareth, with great agreement in the matter, to demonstrate that same this one stands as the promised Messiah — the Evangelical part was written by the four Evangelists — Matthew. XVIII. one Evangelical, another practical, a third epistolary, plus finally a fourth Apocalyptic. And the integral parts belonging toward the New Testament stand as four: XVII. that same which stand as the tables belonging toward the most holy contract between God plus the human race, established by the blood belonging toward the Lamb belonging toward God already slain — written by eight amanuenses, excellent men, witnesses beyond all exception, inspired by the Holy Spirit — there follow the canonical books belonging toward the New Testament. And thus far the Apocrypha also. XVI.
pass_b_english: XVI. And thus far the Apocrypha also. There follow the canonical books of the New Testament, which are the tables of the most holy contract between God and the human race, established by the blood of the Lamb of God already slain — written by eight amanuenses, excellent men, witnesses beyond all exception, inspired by the Holy Spirit.
XVII. And the integral parts of the New Testament are four: one Evangelical, another practical, a third epistolary, and finally a fourth Apocalyptic.

XVIII. The Evangelical part was written by the four Evangelists — Matthew, Mark, Luke, and John — concerning the conception, birth, teaching, life, wonderful works, passion, death, departure to the Father, and return of Jesus of Nazareth, with great agreement in the matter, to demonstrate that this one is the promised Messiah.
source_text: XVI. Et hucusque fuerunt etiam Apocryphi: Sequuntur libri Canonici N.T. qui sunt tabulae sacrosancti contractus inter Deum & genus humanum, agni Dei jam mactati sanguine constabiliti, conscriptae ab octo amanuensibus, viris optimis, testibus omni exceptione majoribus, a Spiritu sancto afflatis. XVII. Partes vero N.T. integrales sunt quatuor: una Euangelica, altera practica, tertia epistolica, quarta denique Apocalyptica. XVIII. Euangelica pars a quatuor Euangelistis, Matthaeo, Marco, Luca, & Johanne de conceptione, nativitate, doctrina, vita, mirandis operibus, passione, morte, abitu ad patrem, redituque Jesu Nazareni, magno in re consensu conscripta est ad demonstrandum, hunc esse promissum Messiam.
